notes:
[Added]
- Add Spanish and Latin American Spanish resource inventories with missing-key, extra-key and translation-divergence diagnostics, plus strict-mode controls.

[Fixes]
- Honor explicitly hidden Updates navigation when Instagram-style status is enabled.
- Restrict LSPosed scope evidence to the current Android user and discard stale cached scope information when live scope reads are unavailable.
- Confirm manual seen-tick changes only after a successful save and retain the last confirmed selection when saving fails.
- Let bottom navigation grow beyond its 72 dp minimum for larger text while retaining the current two-line, ellipsized labels.
- Constrain dashboard hook-status labels and values so they do not compete for the same row space.
- Preserve live hook-status hints and refresh actions in the current dashboard.
- Keep online-presence dots positioned on the measured avatar rim, including right-to-left layouts and rows without a separate photo view.
- Isolate host resource identifier caches by app package to prevent a manager lookup from hiding the corresponding WhatsApp avatar view.
- Use API 24-compatible reflection parameter inspections in presence resolvers.
- Confirm profile-photo exports only after MediaStore acknowledges publication, and remove the newly created row when publication fails.
- Release owned bitmaps when rendering fails and restore admission when worker submission is rejected.
- Distinguish unavailable photos from gallery save errors.
- Handle proximity wake locks when Disable Proximity is enabled so voice-note playback does not request proximity-based screen-off.
- Reject empty default string inventories and optimized Python runs that disable duplicate-resource or regression assertions.
- Restore the complete Spanish and Latin American Spanish resource names for current WAEX interface, emoji settings, update channels and diagnostics.
